text_block.text: 生成された動画：=== REFERENCES === Use the provided images as visual guidance for Riven and the burning village environment. Use the provided final frame from the previous sequence to establish the beginning of this scene. Maintain natural visual continuity. === TECHNICAL === 16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy. Burning village at dusk. Dense smoke, firelight, drifting ash and embers. Grounded realistic human movement. Natural cinematic camera movement. Mysterious and restrained. Keep the action simple and visually clear. No subtitles. No background music. === SCENE === Begin directly with Riven standing inside the burning village. She has stopped moving. Her attention is fixed on the thick smoke ahead. A heavy footstep is heard somewhere inside the smoke. Riven listens. Another faint metallic sound follows. Riven believes it may be her father. She quietly calls: "Father?" There is no answer. Move the camera naturally behind Riven, looking past her into the smoke. A vague humanoid silhouette slowly becomes visible deep inside the smoke ahead. It is heavily obscured. Only the general shape of a person can be seen. No clear face. No clear clothing or armor. No readable identity. The silhouette slowly walks toward Riven. Riven watches it carefully. For a moment, she hopes it might be her father. As the figure comes slightly closer, Riven realizes it is not him. Riven becomes alert. She tightens her grip on her intact sword. She takes one cautious step backward. The silhouette continues approaching through the smoke. One heavy step. Then another. Keep the figure obscured by smoke and backlight. Suddenly, the silhouette accelerates directly toward Riven. The attack happens fast. Riven tries to react, but she is too late. A powerful impact strikes Riven. Do not clearly reveal the attacker or the exact weapon used. The force throws Riven violently backward. Her sword is still intact. The sword is knocked from her hand and slides across the dirt away from her. Riven hits the ground hard. She remains conscious, but stunned and exhausted. Her intact sword now lies several feet away, beyond her immediate reach. The attacker remains obscured by the smoke. CUT.、16:9
